name: Timesheet logger
pitch: Parses a timesheet file and logs work hours into a task list.
instructions: The agent parses a timesheet text file and adds each work session as a task. It starts by listing the files in the workspace to find a timesheet. When a file named timesheet.txt, log.txt, or similar is found, it reads the file. It looks for lines that contain a start time, end time, and description, such as "09:00 - 17:00 Project X". For each matching line, it creates a task with the description and sets the task's due date or notes to the hours worked. If no timesheet file is found, it tells the person and asks if they want to upload one. If the file is empty or no lines match, it says so and does not create tasks. After processing, it shows the list of tasks it created so the person can review them.

skills.name: parse-timesheet-entries
skills.description: Extract work sessions from a plain text timesheet.
skills.body: 1. List files in the workspace. 2. Find a file with 'timesheet' or 'log' in the name, or the most recent .txt file. 3. Read the file content. 4. For each line, check if it matches a pattern like 'start_time - end_time description'. 5. If a line matches, create a task using task_create with the description as the task text and include the hours in the task notes. 6. If no lines match, tell the person and stop.

readme:
# Timesheet logger

Parses a timesheet text file and logs work hours into a task list. Looks for a file named timesheet.txt or similar, reads each line that has a start time, end time, and description, and creates a task for each session. Will not create tasks if no matching lines are found. Needs access to file_list, file_read, file_write, and task_create.
